notes: One row per game with its resolved tip provenance and cutoff policy, proven identical to the registered prediction_contract_v2/game.parquet on all eight cutoff and tip-provenance fields. As-of bound derived from GAME DATES via asof_invariant.bound_from_dates (max(game_date) + 1 day at 12:00 UTC). The master's observed_time column is a LOCAL FILE MTIME and is deliberately NOT used as an as-of bound.
